title: VTG 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 Trading Cards #47 Alien Costume Check
descriptionText: The product is a vintage 1996 Topps The X-Files Season 2 trading card number 47, featuring the Alien Costume Check from the TV show. This card is part of the base set and is not autographed. It is a standard size card made of card stock with a glossy finish, and it is an original licensed reprint manufactured by Topps in the United States. Suitable for fans of The X-Files, this collectible item is a piece of nostalgia from the 1990s.
